title: 第1742章 交个朋友如何第1741章 一辈子都刻骨铭心
slug: 横推九世诸位女帝一直在等我
content_zh:
“哦，了解，了解。”
叶河微微一笑。
而后，他摆了摆手，默默收下了贺礼，笑道：“都是盟友，送什么礼物啊？”
之前忆无情可是吩咐过，天族是盟友，要热情一些，莫要失了礼数。
而那些有仇的，忆无情也一一例举了，告诉他若是有这几个势力来找茬的话，尽管出手教训便好。
他自会解决后事。
之前那一段小插曲也证明了这一点，让他更加了解了忆无情的实力。
恐怖如斯！
他现在实在无法想象，忆无情的实力已经到达了什么层次！
“没事的，这是上面吩咐的。”
女子微微一笑，露出了一抹得体的笑容，带着几分成熟的美。
叶河看的眼睛直冒光，嘴角勾起一抹弧度，开口道：
“姑娘，不知可否添加个通讯晶石？”
“交个朋友如何？”
“啊？”
女子明显愣了一下，有些意外。
看着叶河的眼神，很像那些好色之徒的眼神。
但，这可是一位无上禁忌，怎么会……
与一位无上禁忌交好，这她自然求之不得，但……
看着叶河的眼神，她总觉得，有些危险。

想到这，她连忙摆手，有些害怕的低下脑袋，“抱歉前辈，晚辈还有别的事，先进去了。”
说罢，她立即招呼了身后的天族子弟，快步走了进去。
叶河：“……”
他脸上的笑容立即僵住了，有些许的尴尬。
他环顾了一圈，发现似乎没什么人注意到他，不由松了口气。
确实，太丢脸了。
自己好歹是一位无上禁忌，如此屈尊讨好一个晚辈，还被拒绝了，确实丢脸。
“认真一些，莫要贪图美色。”
他身后默不作声的叶孤云淡淡开口。
叶河脸色一僵，看向了叶孤云，嘴角轻颤，“你……一直在看着？”
“不然呢？”
叶孤云反问一声，眼中带着疑问。
“呃……”
content_en:
"Oh, I understand, I understand."
Ye He smiled slightly.
Then, he waved his hand, silently accepted the gift, and said with a smile: "We are all allies, what gift do you want to give me?"
Yi Qingqing had previously ordered that the Celestial Clan are allies, so be more enthusiastic and don't lose etiquette.
As for those who had a grudge, Yi Qingqing also cited them one by one and told him that if these forces came to make trouble, just teach them a lesson.
He will take care of the aftermath.
The previous episode also proved this and made him understand Yi Wuqing's strength better.
So scary!
He really can't imagine what level Yi Wuqing's strength has reached now!
"It's okay, this is the order from above."
The woman smiled slightly, showing a decent smile with a bit of mature beauty.
Ye He's eyes gleamed when he saw it, the corners of his mouth curved up, and he said:
"Girl, could you please add a communication crystal?"
"How about making a friend?"
"Huh?"
The woman was obviously stunned for a moment, a little surprised.
The eyes looking at Ye He were very similar to the eyes of those lustful people.
However, this is a supreme taboo, how could it be...
Naturally, she couldn't want to be friends with a supreme taboo, but...
Looking at Ye He's eyes, she always felt that there was something dangerous.
Thinking of this, she waved her hands quickly and lowered her head in fear, "I'm sorry, senior, I have other things to do, so I'll go in first."
After saying that, she immediately called to the Heavenly Clan disciples behind her and walked in quickly.
Ye He: "..."
The smile on his face immediately froze, a little embarrassed.
He looked around and found that no one seemed to notice him, and he couldn't help but breathe a sigh of relief.
Indeed, so embarrassing.
After all, he is a supreme taboo. It is really embarrassing for him to condescend to please a junior and be rejected.
"Be serious and don't be greedy for beauty."
Ye Guyun, who was silent behind him, spoke lightly.
Ye He's face froze, and he looked at Ye Guyun, with the corner of his mouth trembling slightly, "You...have been watching?"
"What if?"
Ye Guyun asked back, with questions in his eyes.
"Well……"
